entities.name: UniProt Q5WRS0 aaim-1
observations: Exact sequence match: 515 aa query has 100% identity and coverage to reviewed Caenorhabditis elegans protein aaim-1 (UniProt Q5WRS0).
UniProt annotation: secreted protein that promotes resistance to bacterial pathogens, including Pseudomonas aeruginosa, by inhibiting intestinal colonization.
UniProt annotation: promotes Nosema parisii microsporidian infection in early larval stages and helps ensure proper spore-protein orientation/location during intestinal cell invasion.
GO annotations include extracellular region (GO:0005576) and regulation of entry of bacterium into host cell (GO:2000535).
Sequence-derived: 515 aa, 58.2 kDa, pI 9.15; Pfam AAIM1_N at residues 17–96 and AAIM1_mid at residues 109–192.
